Salam team, Starting this week, since our clients are requesting more transparency. Every task you work on should get a written update in Monday, on the task itself: what you did, what's next, and what you're waiting on. When it's finished, say what was completed and set it to Done. Here's why. Our system now reads those updates every week and turns them into a work report for each client. Nacer and I review it and send it. If it's in Monday, or our internal Whatsapp, the client sees it. If nothing is written, as far as the client knows, nothing was done that week. Good updates are specific ("5 Google listings optimized, 45 posts scheduled through Dec 29", not "worked on GBP"). They're posted the same day and honest about blockers. Hashir's Al Manakeesh update yesterday is the standard. This is also how your work gets judged from now on. Every week we see which open tasks have no update.…
